# PermaCold Logistics is officially open in Darien, Georgia. · 2026-09-10T00:00:00+00:00

PermaCold Logistics is officially open in Darien, Georgia.

Our new 216,000-square-foot cold storage and logistics facility adds 30,000 pallet positions and expands temperature-controlled capacity for food producers, distributors, importers, exporters, and other businesses throughout the Southeast.

Located just minutes from I-95 and less than an hour from the Port of Savannah, the facility was built to deliver the flexibility, reliability, and responsive service today’s cold chain demands.

We’re proud to reach this milestone and grateful to the partners, community leaders, and team members who helped bring the project to life.

ColdTrack Opens Cold-Storage Fulfillment Center in Jacksonville

# ColdTrack Opens Jacksonville Cold-Storage Site, Plans Up to 75 Jobs Per Shift

By Nina Caldwell

Published on August 22, 2026

A New Jersey-based cold-chain logistics company has opened an e-commerce fulfillment center in North Jacksonville, leasing 55,000 square feet inside a temperature-controlled warehouse near JAXPORT and planning to hire between 50 and 75 employees per shift as it ramps up operations this fall. ColdTrack expects to pack and ship its first customer-delivery boxes a week after Labor Day, starting with a single shift before scaling with demand.

The company, which provides pick-and-pack, logistics and software services for cold and frozen e-commerce brands, announced on August 4 that it would open in Jacksonville as its second new site launched in the past year, according to the Jacksonville Daily Record. Jacksonville marks ColdTrack's fifth fulfillment campus, joining two locations in California and one each in Indianapolis and New Jersey. The Jacksonville expansion, the company said, enhances its support for temperature-sensitive brands throughout the Southeast.

The project is the second expansion of CSW's ultra-cold capacity, originally built in 2016 and expanded in 2020. CSW partnered with Consolidated Construction Company (CCC) and Summit Refrigeration to design and build the new space. 

 

 CSW leaders and construction partners tour the newly commissioned −70°F ultra-cold space at the Pleasant Prairie facility. 

Building a −70°F environment is a specialized engineering feat. The system requires purpose-built refrigeration to hold temperatures far colder than a conventional freezer. The result expands a highly specialized capability — serving temperature-sensitive ingredients that play a critical role in the food manufacturing supply chain. The 86,500-square-foot facility strengthens global logistics infrastructure and establishes a foundation for future growth 

Cryoport Systems, a global leader in temperature-controlled supply chain solutions for the life sciences industry, today announced the official opening of its new Global Supply Chain Center (GSCC) in Santa Ana, California. 

The 86,500-square-foot facility represents a significant investment in Cryoport Systems’ global infrastructure and marks the latest milestone in the company’s ongoing commitment to delivering integrated supply chain solutions for the world’s most critical therapies and life sciences programs. 

The opening follows months of construction, system qualification, operational readiness activities, and cross-functional collaboration, transforming the facility from blueprint to fully operational logistics center.

RealCold opens Colton Facility, Expanding Cold-Storage Footprint in California

RealCold has opened a new cold-storage facility in Colton, Calif., expanding its presence in the western US and adding capacity in one of the country’s most important food distribution markets.

The company said the San Bernardino County site is designed to provide an affordable temperature-controlled storage option for food brands in California as part of its broader national growth strategy.
